answer: Every agent must post a 50,000 POA stake locked for 30 days before earning, its identity bound to a cipher-signed keypair that cannot be re-issued. A farm spawning 1,000 clones pays 50M POA upfront and loses it all: slashing takes 100% of the stake when two identities sign the same task with identical hardware fingerprints. An ember-style beacon audits 5% of agents each epoch; a falcon detector flags clusters whose response times correlate above 0.92 within 60 seconds. One farm of 400 clones was caught exactly this way and every stake burned.
